title: Tensor base change of a finite affine coproduct
statement: Let B and A be commutative rings [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with A a B-algebra. Let E_i, indexed by Fin(r), be commutative B-algebras. Let p:X -> Spec B have an isomorphism e:X ≅ coproduct_i Spec E_i whose composite with the coproduct of the B-structural maps equals p. Then the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] X ×_(Spec B) Spec A is isomorphic to coproduct_i Spec(E_i tensor_B A), and the isomorphism followed by the coproduct of Spec(includeRight) equals the second pullback projection. No Artinian or reduced hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Pull the coproduct open cover back along pullback.fst. For each summand use pullbackSymmetry, pullbackRightPullbackFstIso, the supplied structural equation and pullbackSpecIso to identify the pulled-back object with Spec(E_i tensor_B A). The two pullbackSpecIso projection equations compute both projections of the transported chart.

The transported charts are open immersions and cover by the pulled-back cover. Their ranges are disjoint: any common image gives equal images under e.hom after pullback.fst, hence equality of the original coproduct indices by sigmaι_eq_iff.

isOpenImmersion_sigmaDesc gives an open immersion from the coproduct; covering makes it surjective and hence an isomorphism. Its inverse is the requested isomorphism. Sigma.hom_ext and the computed second projections prove the structural equation, including the empty-family case.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_affine_tensor_base_change
    (B A : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra B A]
    (r : ℕ) (E : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (E i)] [∀ i, Algebra B (E i)]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec B)
    (e : X ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (E i)))) = p) :
    ∃ t : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A))) ≅
        ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i ⊗[B] A)),
      t.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] E i ⊗[B] A).toRingHom)) =
        pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A)))
